blocks.html:
Clothes dryers shall be exhausted in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions. Dryer exhaust systems shall be independent of all other systems and shall convey the moisture and any products of combustion to the outside of the building. For the installation of gas dryers, refer to the New York City Fuel Gas Code.
   Exception: This section shall not apply to listed and labeled condensing (ductless) electric clothes dryers.
